Home / Solicitations / SOL-2026-055

Waterfront lighting retrofit, phase two

SOL-2026-055 · Request for proposals · Engineering and Capital Projects

Summary

Closing dateOct 9, 2026, 2 p.m. Central
Issuing departmentEngineering and Capital Projects
ContactMarisol Etchell, buyer, bids@lakefront-vn.example
ResponsesRegistered partners only, through the partner console

Scope of work

Replacement of 380 sodium fixtures along the lakefront path and the marina lots with dimmable LED fixtures on the existing poles, with a lighting controls network. Phase one covered the pier and the band shell.

  • Design-build proposal.
  • Prevailing wage applies.
  • Mandatory pre-proposal site walk, Sep 17, 2026, 10 a.m., at the marina office.

Addenda

  • Addendum 1 (Aug 3, 2026): pole survey added as an appendix.
  • Addendum 2 (Aug 7, 2026): site walk moved to the marina office.

Questions about this solicitation go to the contact above in writing, no later than seven days before the closing date. Answers are published here as addenda.
